verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents non-interactive dependency installation via Brewfile (`brew bundle install`/`check`) and a `NONINTERACTIVE=1` flag for `brew install`, which supports scripted/agent-driven workflows, but the docs pack contains no explicit statement about exit-code semantics or structured error reporting for automation. Community reports also describe surprising side effects during `brew upgrade` (unexpectedly upgrading unrelated casks/packages, breaking environments), undermining confidence that failures/behavior are always clear and predictable for unattended agent use. missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit codes/error format for `brew bundle`/`brew install`, and independent confirmation that non-interactive runs fail predictably without side effects.
